gloss: appearance on the market; circulation; availability

definitions.gloss: appearance on the market; availability; circulation of goods
definitions.explanation: The state of products, especially seasonal foods, becoming widely available in stores and markets.

examples.japanese: ⟦いちご→いちご：01028_ichigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出回|でまわ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: Strawberries have started appearing in stores.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新米|しんまい}→新米：06877_shinmai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出回|でまわ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧になった。
examples.english: The season when new rice appears on the market has arrived.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{暖冬|だんとう}→暖冬：21745_dantou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出回|でまわ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧。
examples.english: Vegetables are appearing on the market earlier this year due to the mild winter.

notes:
The noun form of ⟦{出回|でまわ}る→出回る：11736_demawaru⟧ (to appear on the market, to be in circulation). Commonly used to discuss seasonal availability of foods, especially fruits, vegetables, and fish.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出回|でまわ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧: appearing on the market early
- {出回|でまわ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧: the time when something appears in stores
- {出回|でまわ}り⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧: the quantity available on the market
- ⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出回|でまわ}る→出回る：11736_demawaru⟧: to appear on the market

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{流通|りゅうつう}→流通：05138_ryuutsuu⟧: distribution, circulation — broader term for the movement of goods through supply chains
- ⟦{旬|しゅん}→旬：12716_shun⟧: in season — refers to the peak season for a food item
